scope: Completed LoRA-only runs; separate independent adapter for each model and task. Excludes relational modules and pending epoch-two runs.

lora.target_policy: All torch.nn.Linear descendants of the text/language backbone only; exact targets per model in models.json
lora.variant: standard PEFT LoRA; no DoRA, RS-LoRA or quantization
lora.initialization: PEFT 0.18.1 default init_lora_weights=True (A initialized, B zero)

optimizer.defaults_note: betas, eps and amsgrad were PyTorch 2.7.1 defaults, not explicit source overrides

schedule.resume: Restore optimizer moments, update counter and RNG; warmup is not restarted

batching.four_gpu_gradient_reduction: SUM after each example loss is divided by global-batch size
batching.short_final_batch: Initial 9000-question runs use the remaining 8 examples at each epoch boundary and normalize by actual batch size

loss.objective: teacher-forced causal cross entropy on correct answer letter plus native chat-ending tokens
loss.reduction: Mean over supervised continuation tokens for each example, then mean over examples
loss.warning: Not an eight-class-only loss: predictable chat-ending tokens also contribute to the denominator. Loss magnitude need not be comparable between model tokenizers.

frozen: All pretrained parameters, including vision encoder, multimodal projector/connector, language backbone, embeddings and output head. Only LoRA A/B weights receive gradients.
train_mode: model.train(); modules ending in vision_tower, multi_modal_projector, vision_model, visual or connector set to eval()

seeds.large_pgm_order: fixed nested hash order over shared 240000-question pool, no repeats in epoch one

determinism.original_lfm_clevr: Seeded, but deterministic_algorithms was not enabled; do not promise bitwise rerun equality

inference.scoring: Strict letter parser; invalid output counts as incorrect

data.clevr: Per task: 10000 train-domain questions partitioned by seeded SHA256 ID order into 9000 training and 1000 validation; separate OOD test of 10000
data.pgm_small: 9000 official-train questions, 1000 official-validation questions; repeat epochs until time cutoff
data.pgm_expanded: Same fixed 240000 pool (20% of official 1.2M train), same 1000 official-validation subset; partial pool coverage for SmolVLM2/SpatialEvo
data.input: single RGB composite and task-specific prompt through pinned native processor/chat template; no augmentation or answer permutation
data.pgm_layout: 700x1016 RGB; eight 160x160 context panels in 3x3 grid with missing ninth cell, eight 160x160 candidates A-H in 2x4 grid
data.clevr_layout: two labeled 320x240 candidate scenes side by side for RMTS (688x342 composite); four in 2x2 for identity (688x630 composite)

checkpoint_selection.small_runs: Fixed 128-question validation monitor every 200 optimizer updates, plus endpoint; maximize accuracy, tie-break lower loss; attempt final validation on all 1000
checkpoint_selection.large_pgm: 128-question monitor every 1000 updates, plus endpoint; maximize accuracy, tie-break lower loss; final selected checkpoint validation on 1000
checkpoint_selection.lfm_20pct: Resume selected 144000-example/9000-update checkpoint to prescribed 240000-example/15000-update endpoint; retain optimizer/RNG; evaluate fixed endpoint, not test-selected
